title: Usage Trace
purpose: Charts Claude usage and shows which assistant, worker or channel used it.
description: Every 5 minutes the add-on records the session and week usage percentages. Callers post labelled events (who or what called Claude). The chart shows both, with each event as a band in its own lane. A rise of two points or more that no event explains is flagged as unattributed. Only labels and times are stored, never message text.
navigation: Shows session and week usage as a line chart with event bands
Filters events by source, period and search text
Lists events and unattributed jumps in tables
